notes:
A delivered customer report carried another business's details. This release
fixes that and seven other defects found in the same PDF.

**Paste-ready snippets no longer name anyone.** Five examples carried a
fictional Austin plumbing firm's name, street address, phone number and city —
and one carried a real company's number. The snippets exist to be copied, so a
reader following them published somebody else's contact details. Every example
is now a placeholder, and a rule test bans the whole family.

**"No physical address found" on a site that shows one.** Two causes: the
address was only in the JavaScript-rendered footer, which no address check read
even though Docket renders a sample automatically; and a route address like
`4144 M-72` could not match a pattern that required a street type — which is
most of rural America.

**The cover adds up.** It printed a score of 78 beside "becomes 100/100, worth
22.4 points". Both numbers were right to a decimal place nobody was shown.

**"The five things that matter most" can no longer exclude a HIGH.** Ranking on
reach alone let five MEDIUMs bury a manual-action risk at position eleven.

**The sameAs snippet lists every profile it counted**, instead of three of four,
and employer profiles (Indeed, Glassdoor) are now recognised.

**Two numbers that disagreed now agree**: the method page counted share images
as outbound links, and "substantial pages" had four definitions that had already
drifted apart. The cover also no longer cuts the platform name mid-word.
